title: What came between Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel and Electorate of Hesse?
question: What came between Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel and Electorate of Hesse?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel (1567) to Electorate of Hesse (1814): 0 of cause and effect, 3 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
